title: Microsoft Offered Longtime Workers Up to 39 Weeks of Pay. The Bigger Decision Is When to Claim Social Security.
title_zh: Microsoft 为长期员工提供长达 39 周的工资。更大的决定是何时申请社会保障。
summary: Microsoft's voluntary buyout offered longtime employees far more than a cash payout, and the most valuable piece had almost nothing to do with severance.
summary_zh: 微软的自愿收购为长期员工提供的不仅仅是现金支付，而且最有价值的部分几乎与遣散费无关。

title: Superblocks, AWS sign multi-year deal for enterprise AI on Bedrock
title_zh: Superblocks 与 AWS 签署 Bedrock 企业人工智能多年协议
summary: AWS customers will be able to deploy Superblocks’ generative AI platform within their own environments using AWS security and governance.
summary_zh: AWS 客户将能够使用 AWS 安全性和治理在自己的环境中部署 Superblocks 的生成式 AI 平台。

title: SpaceX’s First Earnings Offer a Chance to Reverse Stock’s Plunge
title_zh: SpaceX 的首次财报为扭转股价暴跌提供了机会
summary: (Bloomberg) -- SpaceX’s first earnings report following its blockbuster initial public offering is one of the most anticipated events of the summer on Wall Street.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——SpaceX 在首次公开募股（IPO）后发布的第一份收益报告是华尔街今年夏天最受期待的事件之一。

title: Pimco Dictates Terms on Oracle Data Center Debt Deal
title_zh: Pimco 规定了 Oracle 数据中心债务交易的条款
summary: Pimco is reshaping AI data center debt by setting stricter financing terms, starting with Oracle's $16B Michigan campus financing.
summary_zh: Pimco 正在通过制定更严格的融资条款来重塑人工智能数据中心债务，首先是 Oracle 的 16B 美元密歇根园区融资。

title: Top Tech Analyst Says Hyperscalers Are the Clear AI Winners, but Beaten-Down Software Offers Value
title_zh: 顶级技术分析师表示，超大规模企业是明显的人工智能赢家，但被淘汰的软件提供了价值
summary: Ray Wang sees the AI market splitting megacaps into two very different investment stories, and the beaten-down names Wall Street has abandoned may be hiding the more compelling opportunity.
summary_zh: Ray Wang 认为人工智能市场将大型企业分成了两个截然不同的投资故事，而华尔街放弃的那些被击败的名字可能隐藏着更引人注目的机会。
